stem.text: The diagram shows two spheres approaching each other head-on. Each sphere has speed $u$. One sphere has mass $2m$ and the other has mass $m$.

stem.alt: Two circles, one labelled 2m and one labelled m, drawn on a horizontal line with arrows pointing towards each other. The speed u is printed beside each arrow.

stem.text: Which diagram shows the result of a perfectly elastic collision?

A.alt: Two circles, one labelled 2m with a leftward arrow labelled u/3, and one labelled m with a rightward arrow labelled 5u/3.

B.alt: Two circles, one labelled 2m with a leftward arrow labelled u/6, and one labelled m with a rightward arrow labelled 2u/3.

C.alt: Two circles, one labelled 2m with a rightward arrow labelled u/6, and one labelled m with a rightward arrow labelled 2u/3.

D.alt: Two touching circles, one labelled 2m and one labelled m, with a rightward arrow labelled u/3.
